activity 11 appearance can 
be appealing
for you to know
Have you seen any food commercials or cooking shows on television? Or maybe you’ve looked at 
food ads in magazines? The people who create these usually hire food stylists to set up the foods 
and food photographers to take photos of them, in order to make their appearance particularly 
appealing. Even someone posting a picture of food on Instagram will set it up to look inviting. 
They do this because they know that how the food looks can trigger someone’s taste buds and 
desire to eat it.
